series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Examiner Satotz leads the applicants to the entrance of the foggy Numere Wetlands, warning them that deceitful monsters roam the marsh. The massive gates shut behind them, cutting off retreat as the runners plunge into the blinding mist.
Prior events (Part 2): Killua warns Gon to move toward the front because Hisoka is lingering in the rear looking for blood. As Leorio falls behind from exhaustion, deceptive predators attack the applicants through the mist, leaving Kurapika and Leorio isolated.
